{{Quote|I have tracked the bounty hunter, Jango Fett, to the droid foundries of Geonosis. The Trade Federation is to take delivery of a droid army here, and it is clear that Viceroy Gunray is behind the assassination attempts on Senator Amidala. The Commerce Guilds and the Corporate Alliance have both pledged their armies to Count Dooku and are forming a—wait. Wait.|Obi-Wan Kenobi is cut off while delivering a message viewed by Ister Paddie|audio=Kenobi-GeonosisReport-AOTC.flac|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Ister Paddie''' was a [[human]] [[senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] who served in [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] [[Loyalist Committee]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]]. In [[22 BBY]], Paddie watched a [[Hologram|holographic]] message from the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] while in [[Emperor's office|Palpatine's office]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Ister Paddie was a [[human]] [[senator]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]]. Paddie was a member of the [[Loyalist Committee]], a group of senators who fostered support for the rule of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].<ref name="CVD" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Paddie was part of a group including other committee members, [[Jedi]], and the chancellor himself, who viewed a [[Hologram|holographic]] message from [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[Office of the Chancellor|Palpatine's office]] in the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="AOTC" />

[[File:KenobisReport-AOTC.png|thumb|left|300px|Ister Paddie viewed a report from Obi-Wan Kenobi in the chancellor's office.]]
In the message, Kenobi, who was on the planet [[Geonosis]], reported that he had followed the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] to a series of [[Geonosis droid factories|droid foundries]] where the [[Trade Federation]] were taking delivery of a [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]]. He also reported that the Federation's [[Viceroy]], [[Nute Gunray]], was behind the recent [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination]] attempts on<ref name="AOTC" /> Loyalist Committee member<ref name="CVD" /> [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and that the [[Corporate Alliance]] and [[Commerce Guild]] were forming an alliance with [[Count]] [[Dooku]], head of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|separatist movement]] trying to break away from the Republic. Before he could finish his report, Kenobi was attacked by a [[droideka]] which walked into view of the recording before the transmission ended. The Jedi and Republic ultimately sent [[Grand Army of the Republic|forces]] to Geonosis to [[First Battle of Geonosis|battle]] the Separatists based on Kenobi's report, beginning the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
Ister Paddie had light skin, [[Color|black]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="CVD" />

==Equipment==
While in Palpatine's office, Paddie wore an ornate golden [[Clothing|outfit]] from [[Halbara]],<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> including an elaborate black headdress.<ref name="CVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BespinCitizenConcept-McQuarrie.png|thumb|right|250px|Ister Paddie's headwear resembles designs for Bespin citizens in ''The Empire Strikes Back''.]]
Ister Paddie was portrayed by [[William Clay]]<ref name="Actor">{{WebCite|url=https://www.nerf-herders-anonymous.com/p/clay-william.html|text=Clay, William|work=[[Nerf-Herders-Anonymous|Nerf-Herders Anonymous]]|archivedate=20210227125821}}</ref> in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> Clay went uncredited for the role but was credited with working as a digital model development and/or construction artist on the film.<ref name="AOTC" /> Paddie's ornate headdress is reminiscent of those worn by the [[Emperor's adviser|Imperial dignitaries]] introduced in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. It is also similar to headgear shown in concept sketches for citizens of [[Bespin]] created for the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|isterpaddie|Paddie, Ister}}</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="VE" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where Paddie was first mentioned prior to the release of ''Attack of the Clones'' in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #47'']], a<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_1.html|Corellia Closes Borders}}</ref> [[March 14]], 2002<ref name="HNN52 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6493893|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-04-18|time=6:27 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> issue published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] website as part of the marketing for the film.<ref name="HNN" /> The article was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
